description: Invoice line, generated once and never updated. Time-weighted from an event-log window x the locked price: whole days for a stable config, exact hours on a day the machine churned (multiple resizes within 24h).

fields.label: Resource
fields.description: resource_id / Price Lock that sourced the locked rate

fields.label: Project
fields.description: The Project this line's resource was tagged into at generation time (immutable snapshot, not a live Link). Empty for an untagged resource.

fields.label: Project Title
fields.description: The Project's title at generation time, so the breakdown still reads correctly after a later rename.

fields.label: Source Team
fields.description: Paid-by-Partner (ADR 0007): set only on a line consolidated onto a partner's invoice from a linked client team's own usage. Immutable snapshot, not a live Link. Empty for a team's own lines.

fields.label: Source Team Name
fields.description: The source team's display name at generation time.

fields.label: Covered By
fields.description: Paid-by-Partner (ADR 0007): set only on a client's own zeroed placeholder line for a day-range a partner paid instead. Immutable snapshot, not a live Link.

fields.label: Covered By Name
fields.description: The covering partner team's display name at generation time.

fields.label: Days
fields.description: Whole days active in the period, for a daily-billed (stable) segment

fields.label: Hours
fields.description: Hours active, for a segment billed hourly on a churn day (multiple resizes within 24h)

fields.label: Charge Date
fields.description: The calendar date an hourly (churn-day) line was incurred; null for whole-day lines that span a range

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: days x (rate / days_in_period), or hours x (rate / (days_in_period x 24)) for an hourly line

fields.label: Covered Amount
fields.description: Paid-by-Partner (ADR 0007): set only on a `covered_by` placeholder line — what this day-range would have cost, for visibility. Not part of `amount` (which stays 0) and not billed to this team.

name: Invoice Line Item
